# HexPiece 3.2.4

Nika fruit (Gear 5) rework, part 2: a faster, harder-hitting transformation and no more wobbling punches. Not tested in game yet:
the build and all tests pass, and every changed animation was rendered and checked from the front, the side and three-quarter.

**Transformation (Z)**
- Takes about 4 seconds instead of 8.5. Everything keeps its rhythm: the burst, the drums, the leap, the clouds, the white skin and
  the landing all happen at the same moments, just twice as fast.
- New animation. It hunches as the first heartbeat hits, then winds the power in low. Five chest pounds land on the five drum
  beats: right, left, right, left, then both fists at once. Each fist winds far out to the side with the chest puffed out, then
  slams onto the chest as the body hunches into it.
- Then the body goes loose like rubber, crouches deep, and launches with the arms flung up in a V. It floats leaning back with the
  arms wide, and squashes down on landing into the Gear 5 stance.

**Punch and Gatling (third person)**
- No more wobble. The punch used to swing the whole body forward and back, twist the torso and turn the head every time. Now it
  leans into the hit once and settles.
- Gatling leans in steadily with only a small twist per fist (it used to twist the torso and head every 3 ticks).
- The Gear 5 stance keeps its rubbery bob, but no longer locks your head: you can look around freely while standing in Gear 5.
- First person is unchanged, as you asked: the arms you see there are exactly the same.
